slides.title: Build the screening set around the decision
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
bullets: Primary potency assay: rank activity under defined conditions.
Selectivity sweep: compare off-target inhibition at a stated concentration.
hERG automated patch clamp and 5-isoform CYP panel: identify liabilities for follow-up.
RED PPB: measure binding with recovery checks.
Agree the screen gate, sample requirements and reporting limits before study start.

slides.title: Plate acceptance comes first
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
bullets: Define control ranges and repeat rules in the study plan.
Inspect reference response, vehicle baseline and assay signal before releasing results.
Record exclusions and repeat reasons on the run sheet.
bullets_right: Separate assay failure from a compound-specific limitation.
Retain qualified results with their notes.
slides.notes: Acceptance limits are assay- and study-specific; this deck does not replace the approved run sheet.

slides.title: Primary potency assay
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
bullets: Concentration response in nM or µM with assay conditions stated.
Agree ATP conditions, concentration spacing, replication and reference compound.
Inspect curve shape and assay window before ranking.
bullets_right: Require compound identity, test-lot reference and stock concentration.
Confirm solvent compatibility and solubility across the requested range.
Report incomplete responses as bounded or qualified results.
slides.notes: Biochemical potency does not establish cellular activity or mechanism.

slides.title: Selectivity sweep
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
bullets: Agree the off-target kinase list and screening concentration.
Report inhibition in percent at that concentration; preserve the full fingerprint.
Use follow-up concentration responses for selected findings.
bullets_right: Provide compatible stock sufficient for the panel and controls.
Retain identity across potency and sweep run sheets.
Choose representatives for the chemistry question, not only potency.

slides.title: hERG automated patch clamp
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
bullets: Ravi Deshmukh leads electrophysiology interpretation.
Assess vehicle response, cell stability and E-4031 response before release.
Report cell-level responses, summary IC50 and tested concentration limit.
bullets_right: Confirm stock concentration, solvent and requested top concentration.
Discuss solubility constraints before test-lot dispatch.
Keep cell-count, unstable-response and censored-result notes attached.
slides.notes: The channel result needs exposure context. A censored IC50 is a bound.

slides.title: 5-isoform CYP panel
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
bullets: Screen inhibition under defined substrate and incubation conditions.
Interpret reference-inhibitor response before ranking.
Use 3A4 concentration response for a selected follow-up question.
bullets_right: Provide identity, stock concentration and solvent composition.
Confirm material against the agreed range and repeat allowance.
Do not turn a single screening point into an IC50.

slides.title: RED PPB
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
bullets: Equilibrium dialysis with matrix and incubation conditions stated.
Check recovery before interpreting bound and unbound fractions.
Investigate low recovery before compound ranking.
bullets_right: Agree species, matrix, test concentration and stock compatibility.
Discuss adsorption and solubility concerns before starting.
Keep recovery with the binding result in every handover.
slides.notes: A repeat uses a documented change and retains the original run record.

slides.title: Sample requirements: agree before shipment
slides.footer: Brindlewythe Biosciences Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

rows: Compound identifier and test-lot reference matching dispatch list
Available amount or volume and physical form
Storage, stability and known solubility constraints
Assays, concentration range and repeat allowance
Contact for discrepancies and sample reconciliation

slides.notes: Henning Flantz coordinates reconciliation. Material requirements are calculated for the agreed study, not a universal submission amount.

Assay run and controls > Plate acceptance
Plate acceptance > Qualified results and ranking
Qualified results and ranking > Client screen gate

slides.notes: A failed acceptance step returns to the run sheet and repeat decision before ranking. John Mckinney coordinates handover.
